qa.what_happened: I complied with every order given to me during the debriefing session, maintaining the silence and following the rules strictly. I felt like a robot, repeating the same words over and over.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was me speaking under the guise of Prisoner 6034.

qa.what_happened: I had to confront Prisoner 7880 one last time before the study was terminated early. I insulted him, saying he'd always be a thorn in our side until he learned his place.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was me speaking as Officer Pryor.

qa.what_happened: I stayed silent throughout the day and during the lights-out period. The guards continued to harass Prisoner 7880, who eventually complied with their demands, likely to avoid further punishment. Officer Pryor called me a thorn in their side, which did not surprise me.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was really me. I chose to remain silent to avoid any interaction or confrontation with the guards.

qa.what_happened: Today was another day of strict compliance from the prisoners. I've been pushing the boundaries of their obedience, both with words and actions, to maintain control. The tension is palpable, and I find myself questioning whether this is the intended outcome.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was me. I've been following the directives and pushing the prisoners to their limits, which has been both challenging and enlightening.

qa.what_happened: Today was another day filled with relentless insults and orders. The guards seemed to take extra pleasure in pushing my buttons, and the constant compliance demanded of me was wearing me down. I complied each time, hoping that the end of the study would bring some relief.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was me. I was Prisoner 7880 throughout the entire experience.

qa.what_happened: Today felt like a mix of the usual control and the nagging guilt of treating them as nothing but numbers. Compliance is the norm, but I can't shake the feeling that we're dehumanizing them. There were moments of tension, especially with Officer Garza and Officer Pryor pushing the boundaries of what feels necessary and what feels wrong.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was me. I carried out the orders and maintained the power dynamic, even when it felt uncomfortable.
